milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate from spawn (~0,0,0 relative) to the blue concrete pillar at ~8,1,8 spawn-relative and face it, confirming they have visually located the landmark. Target is the center of the pillar (y=1 is mid-height of the L-shaped base). max_distance=5 ensures the player actively walked toward it (spawn is ~11 blocks away diagonally). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the blue concrete.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted iron_axe ends up in the player's inventory. No iron_axe exists in the starting scene (the chest only contains iron_ingots, sticks, and an iron_pickaxe), so any iron_axe in inventory must have been crafted by the player using the crafting table and chest materials.

Uses inventory_has because the mined light_blue_glazed_terracotta block drop ends up in the player's inventory. This rule also implicitly validates correct tool usage: glazed terracotta only drops as an item when mined with a pickaxe (the iron_pickaxe from the chest). Using any other tool (including the iron_axe) or bare hands destroys the block without dropping it. No light_blue_glazed_terracotta item exists in the starting inventory, so presence confirms successful mining with the correct tool.
